README.md:
# sales — data product (dbt project)

Generated by the Sovereign Agentic OS from the domain's dataset definitions. The OS is the
writer: every dataset, composition, quality rule, sync or publish change in the UI or through the
OS MCP regenerates this project and commits it as the acting user. Read it, export it, mirror it;
edit the datasets in the OS.

## Run it

```sh
export TRINO_HOST=trino TRINO_PORT=8080 TRINO_USER=dbt-runner OS_PRINCIPAL=<your-principal>
dbt parse --profiles-dir .
dbt build --profiles-dir . --select <model>+
```

`profiles.yml` reads only environment variables. `OS_PRINCIPAL` is the Trino user dbt impersonates;
Trino→OPA governs that identity exactly as the OS UI does. No credential lives in this repository.

## Layout

- `models/sources.yml` — Bronze landings and federated tables dbt reads but never writes
- `models/silver/`, `models/gold/` — promoted (domain) layers; `models/personal/<uid>/` — personal lane
- `models/**/schema.yml` — descriptions and the quality rules as tests
- `tests/generic/` — the `range` and `not_blank` tests the OS rules compile to
- `macros/os_maintenance.sql` — weekly Iceberg `optimize` + `expire_snapshots`, run by Dagster per schema
- `os/schedules.yml` — sync schedules (cron, UTC, principal) for the Dagster code location
- `os/external.yml` — sources dbt cannot model (Kafka offsets, API batch); Dagster assets
- `models/semantic/<model>.yml` — the `semantic_models:` + `metrics:` of promoted datasets
  (a personal dataset's sit in `models/personal/<uid>/semantic/`; promotion moves the file)
- `models/os/os_time_spine_day.sql` — the daily time spine (a view over `sequence(...)`)

## Models

- `models/gold/gold_orders.sql` — pass-through, schema `sales`
- `models/personal/bea/gold_draft_signups.sql` — pass-through, schema `personal_bea`
- `models/silver/silver_orders.sql` — pass-through, schema `sales`

## Metrics (dbt semantic layer)

This project targets **one** semantic spec version: `dbt-semantic-interfaces 0.8.5`
(= dbt-core 1.10); every field emitted is also valid on dbt-core 1.9, which is what
the OS images carry today (`dbt-core>=1.9,<1.10`). The time spine uses the dbt >= 1.9
`time_spine` model property, never the legacy `metricflow_time_spine` name.

Query them with MetricFlow from a clone:

```sh
mf query --metrics <metric> --group-by metric_time__month
```

- `aov` (ratio) — OS metric `ds_orders1.aov`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `customers` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.customers`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `orders` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.orders`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `revenue` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `revenue_eu` (simple) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_eu`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `revenue_per_customer` (derived) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_per_customer`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `revenue_rt` (cumulative) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_rt`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `revenue_t7d` (cumulative) — OS metric `ds_orders1.revenue_t7d`, in `models/semantic/sales__orders.yml`
- `sales__draft_signups__revenue` (simple) — OS metric `ds_draft001.revenue`, in `models/personal/bea/semantic/sales__draft_signups.yml`

### Not emitted

These OS metrics have no faithful form in this spec version, so nothing was written for them:

- `revenue_next7` on OS dataset `ds_orders1` — a leading window has no dbt metric form (dbt cumulative metrics look backwards only)

models/gold/gold_orders.sql:
-- gold_orders — gold layer of OS dataset ds_orders1 ("Orders", domain sales).
-- Generated by Sovereign OS from the dataset definition; edit the dataset in the OS, not this file.
-- Pass-through: this layer carries the layer below forward unchanged.

select * from {{ ref('silver_orders') }}
models/gold/schema.yml:
version: 2
models:
  - name: gold_orders
    description: gold layer of OS dataset ds_orders1 ("Orders"). Web-shop orders, one row per order.
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_layer: gold
        os_tier: asset
        os_owner: amir
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        description: Order key
      - name: order_date
        description: Order date
      - name: region
        description: Billing region
      - name: net_amount
        description: Net amount (EUR)
      - name: customer_id
        description: Customer key
models/os/schema.yml:
version: 2
models:
  - name: os_time_spine_day
    description: Daily time spine for the dbt semantic layer (2015-01-01 .. current_date + 365d). Generated by Sovereign OS.
    time_spine:
      standard_granularity_column: date_day
    columns:
      - name: date_day
        description: One row per calendar day.
        granularity: day
models/personal/bea/gold_draft_signups.s:
-- gold_draft_signups — gold layer of OS dataset ds_draft001 ("Draft Signups", domain sales).
-- Generated by Sovereign OS from the dataset definition; edit the dataset in the OS, not this file.
-- Pass-through: this layer carries the layer below forward unchanged.

select * from {{ source('personal_bea', 'bronze_draft_signups') }}
models/personal/bea/schema.yml:
version: 2
models:
  - name: gold_draft_signups
    description: gold layer of OS dataset ds_draft001 ("Draft Signups"). A personal dataset still in the owner's lane.
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_draft001
        os_layer: gold
        os_tier: dataset
        os_owner: bea
    columns:
      - name: signup_id
        description: Signup key
      - name: signup_date
        description: Signup date
      - name: net_amount
        description: Net amount
models/personal/bea/semantic/sales__draf:
semantic_models:
  - name: sales__draft_signups
    description: A personal dataset still in the owner's lane.
    model: ref('gold_draft_signups')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: signup_date
    entities:
      - name: draft_signups
        type: primary
        expr: signup_id
    dimensions:
      - name: signup_date
        type: time
        description: Signup date
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
        expr: signup_date
    measures:
      - name: sales__draft_signups__revenue
        agg: sum
        expr: net_amount
metrics:
  - name: sales__draft_signups__revenue
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: sales__draft_signups__revenue
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_draft001
        os_member: sales__Draft_Signups.revenue
        os_metric: ds_draft001.revenue
models/semantic/sales__orders.yml:
semantic_models:
  - name: sales__orders
    description: Web-shop orders, one row per order.
    model: ref('gold_orders')
    defaults:
      agg_time_dimension: order_date
    entities:
      - name: orders
        type: primary
        expr: order_id
    dimensions:
      - name: customer_id
        type: categorical
        description: Customer key
        expr: customer_id
      - name: order_date
        type: time
        description: Order date
        type_params:
          time_granularity: day
        expr: order_date
      - name: region
        type: categorical
        description: Billing region
        expr: region
    measures:
      - name: customers
        agg: count_distinct
        expr: customer_id
        config:
          meta:
            os_agg: count_distinct_approx
      - name: orders
        agg: count
      - name: revenue
        agg: sum
        description: Net revenue booked.
        expr: net_amount
        label: Revenue
      - name: revenue_eu
        agg: sum
        expr: net_amount
      - name: revenue_rt
        agg: sum
        expr: net_amount
      - name: revenue_t7d
        agg: sum
        expr: net_amount
metrics:
  - name: aov
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: revenue
      denominator: orders
    label: Average Order Value
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.aov
        os_metric: ds_orders1.aov
  - name: customers
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: customers
    config:
      meta:
        os_agg: count_distinct_approx
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.customers
        os_metric: ds_orders1.customers
  - name: orders
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: orders
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.orders
        os_metric: ds_orders1.orders
  - name: revenue
    description: Net revenue booked.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue
    label: Revenue
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.revenue
        os_metric: ds_orders1.revenue
  - name: revenue_eu
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: revenue_eu
    filter: "{{ Dimension('orders__region') }} = 'eu'"
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.revenue_eu
        os_metric: ds_orders1.revenue_eu
  - name: revenue_per_customer
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: revenue / customers
      metrics:
        - customers
        - revenue
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.revenue_per_customer
        os_metric: ds_orders1.revenue_per_customer
  - name: revenue_rt
    type: cumulative
    type_params:
      measure: revenue_rt
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.revenue_rt
        os_metric: ds_orders1.revenue_rt
  - name: revenue_t7d
    type: cumulative
    type_params:
      measure: revenue_t7d
      cumulative_type_params:
        window: 7 day
    config:
      meta:
        os_dataset: ds_orders1
        os_member: sales__Orders.revenue_t7d
        os_metric: ds_orders1.revenue_t7d
